metadata.description: Plugins from the ASCENT engineering framework. Interim home until lloydbriantech-claude-marketplace exists (ADR-009).

plugins.name: ascent-security
plugins.description: Read-only security checks for any repository: .env discipline, hardcoded credentials, container privilege, nginx security headers, production URLs and dynamic code execution, plus a security-auditor agent.

plugins.name: ascent-delivery
plugins.description: The ASCENT delivery loop for any repository: build, test with negative controls, gate, independent review with a finding verifier, and an operator runbook. A hook blocks git writes and deploys for Claude.

plugins.name: ascent-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture review for any repository: quality attributes against measurable targets, design principles, deployment options with dated cost estimates, a CloudFormation static-site blueprint with template checks, and a read-only architecture-reviewer agent.

plugins.name: ascent-ux
plugins.description: UX review for any web UI: WCAG 2.2 AA evidence with static checks and a Playwright browser pass, design-token contrast checks, five accessible design directions shown as mocks, and a read-only ux-reviewer agent.

plugins.name: ascent-ops
plugins.description: Operations review for any repository: infrastructure as code with secure-by-design configuration, zero-touch scripts and runbooks with pre-flight and post-flight checks, Maintenance and Operations and Troubleshooting manuals kept current with diagrams and a dependency map, and a read-only ops-reviewer agent.
